title: IBM Process Mining 2.0.0 through 2.2.1 could allow an authenticated user to perform unauthorized actions due to…
description: IBM Process Mining versions 2.0.0 through 2.2.1 contain a vulnerability where an authenticated user could perform unauthorized actions. This occurs because security controls intended to be enforced on the server side are instead enforced on the client side, allowing bypass by a user with valid credentials.
